controls.title: Post orders
controls.objective: Each security post has current written post orders that the officer on duty has read.

questions.text: Are written post orders present at each post, dated within the last 12 months, and signed as read by the officer on duty?
questions.guidance: Check each post. Partial: present but outdated or unsigned. Photograph the cover page.

questions.text: When asked, how accurately can the officer on duty describe the response to an alarm at their post?

anchors.label: Partial
anchors.description: Describes some steps but misses notification or escalation.

anchors.label: Complete
anchors.description: Describes assessment, notification, and escalation matching the post orders.

questions.guidance: Ask one open question and compare the answer to the post orders.

controls.title: Patrol verification
controls.objective: Patrols are scheduled and completion is verified by an electronic tour system or logged checkpoints.

evidence.description: Guard tour reports for the last 30 days

questions.text: Are patrols verified by an electronic guard tour system or checkpoint log?
Percentage of scheduled checkpoint scans completed over the last 30 days
questions.guidance: Take the guard tour report total completed divided by scheduled.

controls.title: Officer licensing and training
controls.objective: Every officer on the roster holds required licenses and documented site training.

evidence.description: Roster with license numbers and training records

questions.text: Number of officers on the current roster without a current license (where required) or a documented site orientation
questions.guidance: Sample the roster against license records and training sign-offs.

controls.title: Officer communications
controls.objective: Each officer on duty can reach the supervisor and the monitoring point at all times.

questions.text: Does each officer on duty carry a radio or phone that was tested at the start of the shift and reaches the supervisor and monitoring point?
questions.guidance: Ask to see the shift check. Partial: device carried but no test record.

questions.text: Measured time for the supervisor or monitoring point to answer a test call from the post
questions.guidance: Place a test call with permission.

controls.title: Post staffing
controls.objective: Required posts are staffed for their scheduled hours.

evidence.description: Shift schedules and time records for the last 30 days

questions.text: Hours in the last 30 days in which a required post was unstaffed
questions.guidance: Compare scheduled coverage with time records.

controls.title: Incident logging and review
controls.objective: Security incidents are logged with time, location, description, and action, and reviewed by a supervisor.

evidence.description: Incident log for the last 30 days

questions.text: Are incidents recorded with time, location, description, and action taken, and reviewed by a supervisor within 24 hours?
questions.guidance: Sample 5 entries. Partial: entries complete but not reviewed.

questions.text: Are physical incidents that could affect information systems (for example a forced server room door) reported to IT security?
questions.guidance: Ask for the procedure or a recent example.
